clauses.quote: This option shall only be available to permanent status Teachers whose most recent evaluation score was “Effective” or higher.

Excessed permanent status Teachers who have been unable to secure a new placement during the sixty (60) calendar days following the effective date of the excess, and who have not selected Option 1 or Option 2 above, shall have the right to select Option 3: An Extra Year to Secure a New Position (hereafter referred to as the “Extra Year.”)
